subject: Which SOC 2 package is the authoritative one?
messages:
From: Security Team <security@acme-health.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-health.com
Date: 2027-10-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for latest SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Ben / Evelyn,

Hope you’re well. We received a SOC 2 Type II package from Redwood today but there’s some metadata that looks off compared to what we have on file. The file we were sent is named "SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026-09-30.pdf" but the cover page lists an audit ID that appears to be from a prior engagement (AUD-2025-911). Our procurement team flagged it as potentially expired.

Could you confirm: 1) which SOC 2 package is the authoritative/current Type II for Redwood, and 2) whether there is a bridge letter or reissued document that clarifies the audit period? If there was a reissue, we need the reissue date and a signed bridge or interim attestation to attach to our vendor file.

We’ll also need an evidence index or list of artifacts if possible. Procurement requires the final audit identifier and a DocuSign link if the bridge requires signature.

Thanks — please loop in whoever owns SOC 2 at Redwood if different.

Regards,
Claire Stone
Security Program Manager, Acme Health
security@acme-health.com

Attachments received: (none with this message)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Stone <security@acme-health.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-13T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 artifacts

Claire — thanks for the heads up. I’m escalating to our compliance lead; copying Marissa Cole from Trust & Security who manages SOC 2 packaging.

Short answer: we did have a reissue earlier this quarter that affected file naming and the audit ID metadata, which has caused confusion for a few customers. I don’t have the signed bridge in my mailbox yet but Marissa will confirm the authoritative file and send the bridge and evidence index.

I’ll hold on next steps until we confirm the package details — appreciate you flagging AUD-2025-911.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: (referenced later)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Stone <security@acme-health.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-15T08:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Claire — sorry for the confusion and thanks for calling this out. I own the SOC 2 release process. Quick summary of what happened: our auditor issued a re-packaged Type II report on 2027-10-01 to correct an internal metadata tag (audit ID) and to include an updated evidence index. The audit period covered is unchanged (2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30); the reissue did not extend the period, it corrected the report packaging.

What we are sending now (and attaching here) is the authoritative package:
- SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026-09-30.pdf (reissued 2027-10-01, new internal audit identifier AUD-2026-091)
- bridge_letter_20271001.pdf (signed by auditor — explains reissue reason)
- evidence_index_2027-10.csv (index of artifacts supplied during audit)

Notes: the filename matches the original to avoid breaking links for customers, but the PDF cover page now shows AUD-2026-091 and a reissue stamp. I’m attaching the bridge letter which explicitly states the reissue is administrative and confirms the audit period. If Acme requires a signed vendor-facing attestation (DocuSign), we can route the bridge for signature — I’ve included a DocuSign link below for convenience.

Let me know if you need the auditor contact and we can provide a point of contact for verification.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026-09-30.pdf (reissued), bridge_letter_20271001.pdf, evidence_index_2027-10.csv

From: Claire Stone <security@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-health.com
Date: 2027-10-16T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 artifacts

Thanks Marissa — that explanation helps a lot. Two quick clarifications from our side before we close the record: 1) Procurement needs an explicit line we can paste into their vendor file that says "This reissued report (AUD-2026-091) is administrative and does not change the audit period (2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30)" — can you provide that as a one-line statement in the bridge or as a short attestation? 2) Would you confirm whether the new audit identifier (AUD-2026-091) supersedes the old one for all vendor-tracking systems, or should we keep both IDs on record?

Also — please send the DocuSign link for the bridge if you plan to route it to an authorized signer at Acme. Once procurement has the signed bridge and evidence index, we should be good to move to vendor approval.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Claire
Security Program Manager, Acme Health

On Oct 15, 2027, at 08:48, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Claire — sorry for the confusion and thanks for calling this out. I own the SOC 2 release process. The audit period covered is unchanged (2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30); the reissue did not extend the period, it corrected the report packaging.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Stone <security@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 artifacts

Claire — quick follow-up. Per Marissa: we are providing the one-line attestation for procurement below and routing the bridge for signature as requested.

"This reissued report (AUD-2026-091) is administrative in nature and does not change the audited period of coverage, which remains 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30."

Action items completed:
- Bridge letter sent via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/requests/3f2a9b-reissue-sign
- Evidence index uploaded to shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedactedDOCS
- Attached: SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026-09-30.pdf (reissued), bridge_letter_20271001.pdf, evidence_index_2027-10.csv

If procurement confirms they want both IDs noted we can provide both (AUD-2025-911 and AUD-2026-091) as historical metadata, but the operationally authoritative ID for current vendor tracking is AUD-2026-091.

Please reply if you need the auditor contact. Thanks for working through this quickly.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026-09-30.pdf, bridge_letter_20271001.pdf, evidence_index_2027-10.csv
